welcome.sourceText: Welcome, storyteller! Let's make a tale together.
welcome.transcript: Welcome, storyteller! Let's make a tale together!

choose-world.sourceText: Forest, ocean, or moon. Where shall our story begin?
choose-world.transcript: Forest, ocean, or moon. Where shall our story begin?

all-clues.sourceText: You found every story word. Now choose what happens next!
all-clues.transcript: You found every story word. Now choose what happens next!

story-ready.sourceText: Your story is ready. Tell it in your own words.
story-ready.transcript: Your story is ready. Tell it in your own words.

record-ready.sourceText: Press and hold the red microphone while you tell your story. It stays on this device.
record-ready.transcript: Press and hold the red microphone while you tell your story. It stays on this device.

recorded.sourceText: Your recording stays here until you leave this story. Tap replay to hear it.
recorded.transcript: Your recording stays here until you leave this story. Tap replay to hear it.

mic-fallback.sourceText: No microphone? No problem. Tell your story out loud to someone nearby.
mic-fallback.transcript: No microphone? No problem. Tell your story out loud to someone nearby.

guided-finish.sourceText: Wonderful telling! You made a brand new story.
guided-finish.transcript: Wonderful telling! You made a brand new story.

intro-forest.sourceText: Pip the fox found a path with two surprises. Tap the glowing pictures and name what you see.
intro-forest.transcript: Pip the fox found a path with two surprises. Tap the glowing pictures and name what you see.

intro-ocean.sourceText: Willa the whale found a sparkling reef. Tap the glowing pictures and name what you see.
intro-ocean.transcript: Willa the whale found a sparkling reef. Tap the glowing pictures and name what you see.

intro-moon.sourceText: Nova the moon bunny found a trail of stardust. Tap the glowing pictures and name what you see.
intro-moon.transcript: Nova the moon bunny found a trail of stardust. Tap the glowing pictures and name what you see.

word-forest-fox.sourceText: Fox. Pip is a curious fox.
word-forest-fox.transcript: Fox. Pip is a curious fox.

word-forest-stream.sourceText: Stream. The stream sparkles and splashes.
word-forest-stream.transcript: Stream. The stream sparkles and splashes.

word-forest-flowers.sourceText: Flowers. The flowers bloom in many colors.
word-forest-flowers.transcript: Flowers. The flowers bloom in many colors.

word-ocean-whale.sourceText: Whale. Willa is a gentle whale.
word-ocean-whale.transcript: Whale. Willa is a gentle whale.

word-ocean-coral.sourceText: Coral. The coral makes a colorful sea garden.
word-ocean-coral.transcript: Coral. The coral makes a colorful sea garden.

word-ocean-turtle.sourceText: Turtle. The sea turtle glides slowly.
word-ocean-turtle.transcript: Turtle. The sea turtle glides slowly.

word-ocean-bubbles.sourceText: Bubbles. The bubbles float up, up, up.
word-ocean-bubbles.transcript: Bubbles. The bubbles float up, up, up.

word-moon-bunny.sourceText: Bunny. Nova is a brave moon bunny.
word-moon-bunny.transcript: Bunny. Nova is a brave moon bunny.

word-moon-crater.sourceText: Crater. A crater is a round hollow on the moon.
word-moon-crater.transcript: Crater. A crater is a round hollow on the moon.

word-moon-rover.sourceText: Rover. The rover rolls over moon rocks.
word-moon-rover.transcript: Rover. The rover rolls over moon rocks.

word-moon-star.sourceText: Star. The golden star twinkles hello.
word-moon-star.transcript: Star. The golden star twinkles hello.

prompt-forest-1.transcript: What happens next? Will Pip cross the bridge, or sail in the leaf boat?
